reasons: indie rock singles from the blog
pitchTip: Follow their brief: 'Muziek doorsturen en feedback krijgen kan via mail of onderstaand formulier' - send a mail to beir@dansendeberen.be; they try to reply to everyone. Physical post: Cipressenstraat 18, 8800 Roeselare.

Follow their brief: Features and Spotify playlist adds, singles only: email Kris with links (YouTube/Spotify/SoundCloud), photos, bio and quotes. No attachments. Release date in the subject line, personal note, at most one follow-up. No AI songs. Paid alternative with guaranteed response: SubmitHub (https://www.submithub.com/blog/from-the-strait, code 'ftscoupon' for 10% off).

Follow their brief: Contact page: 'The quickest and most effective way is by submitting songs to our open submission playlist.' Picks move to the Best Songs of the Month playlist, and about 75% of editorial comes from there. Playlist description: the release date must be in the current month, and 'we lean indie and alt across all genres'.
Follow their brief: Contact page 'Send Your Music!': submit via SubmitHub (sbmt.to/mp3hugger) 'or do it the old fashioned way by dropping us an email' to contact@mp3hugger.com.

Follow their brief: 'Friday Setlist: a curated playlist of new independent music, sent every Friday to our newsletter subscribers. Requirements: Track link. Ideal lead time: 1 week.' 'If one or more of these sound like a fit for you, please reach out' (the link goes to submissions@turnandwork.com). No AI-made music. Coverage is free.

reasons: alt and indie rock on Groover
pitchTip: Follow their brief: Groover profile offers 'Add to one of our playlists'; genres alt rock, garage, indie rock, post punk, punk. Playlist itself: 'Chaque fin de mois sur les réseaux sociaux, Mowno lance un appel à contribution' (monthly reader call on socials).
Follow their brief: Contact page 'Send Your Music!': submit via SubmitHub (sbmt.to/mp3hugger) 'or do it the old fashioned way by dropping us an email' to contact@mp3hugger.com.

reasons: wants Wolf Alice / Fontaines D.C. sounds
pitchTip: Follow their brief: 'I turned off all email notifications a few years ago. So if you'd like me to listen to your song, please send it via SubmitHub.' Full-stream link needed. Also on Groover.

Follow their brief: Contact page sends bands to Groover ('Bandas e artistas: envie seu material'). Groover offer: 'Add to our official playlist, publish articles and interviews, share on our social networks.'
Follow their brief: 'Step 1: Upload your new song, demo, or live recording to Tidal Upload' then 'Step 2: Submit your Tidal Upload link here!' (thewildhoneypie.com/submit). No AI music.

Follow their brief: 'If you'd rather not use the form, you can email me directly HERE' (decodes to editor@tinnitist.com). Send name, press release/bio and track link. Paid alternatives: Groover (https://groover.co/band/sendtrack/?add=1803), SharePRO and OTONAMI. The site form asks for a donation with a refund if he can't find a spot. Don't use it, because that is pay-for-coverage; the email route is free.

Follow their brief: 'Or fill out the contact form here. If you're submitting via the form, please include a URL to relevant artist pages, a brief (3-5 sentence) overview of yourself' plus a short description of the song. The SubmitHub link on the page now resolves to a generic SubmitHub page (profile appears inactive), so use the form.

Follow their brief: Contact page: 'Please send any requests for coverage through to the editorial team.' Lists Features/Live Editor Jamie Giberti (jamieg.rocksins@gmail.com), Deputy Editor Jemma Dodd and News Editor John Layland.
Follow their brief: 'Please only send Submissions through Submithub... If we are not listed, we probably don't have time to listen to new submissions for the moment.'

Follow their brief: Via Groover. 'I promise to listen to your material several times... I will make a complete review with my opinion.' Other playlists are Latin America only; this one appears open to all.
Follow their brief: Via Groover (homepage 'Envíanos' widget). Offer: add to the 'nuevo indie 2026' playlist, YouTube video and article.

reasons: alt and DIY from Scotland and beyond
pitchTip: Follow their brief: No explicit submission guidance; about page shows music@netsounds.co.uk as a 'Contact us' link. Site says 'We champion alternative and DIY new music that we love from Scotland and far beyond.'
Follow their brief: Impressum lists 'Kontakt: pickypromo[at]gmail.com' (promo address) but does not explicitly invite music submissions.
